_about: Hospital systems a hospital can pick in the set-up (GET /api/tb/his/kinds). Data only: a preset chooses a connection method (kind) and its defaults; it never adds support the code does not have. status is 'tested with the demo hospital' only for the demo; every other preset is 'by standard, not tested with the product'. Facts and sources: docs/his-adapters/RESEARCH.md. Design: docs/his-adapters/DESIGN.md. interface says how much is known about the product's own interface (documented / by standard / vendor claim only / no public API found / interface not known).
statuses: by standard, not tested with the product

presets.name: Vaidyx demo hospital (SYNTHETIC)
presets.notes: The demo hospital on this server: FHIR R4 in ABDM / NRCeS shapes with a bearer token. Synthetic patients only.

presets.name: ABDM / NRCeS FHIR server (hospital that is an ABDM provider)
presets.status: by standard, not tested with the product
presets.notes: Only for a hospital that keeps its own FHIR R4 store in NRCeS shapes (DocumentReference, DiagnosticReport, Provenance) that can be queried. ABDM compliant means the product pushes record bundles through the ABDM gateway after patient consent; it is not a FHIR server to query (RESEARCH.md section 2). For those products choose 'ABDM record bundles' (bundles handed over as files).

presets.name: Bahmni / OpenMRS (FHIR2 module)
presets.status: by standard, not tested with the product
presets.notes: Plain FHIR R4 at /openmrs/ws/fhir2/R4 (capability at /metadata) with HTTP basic; ask for a read-only OpenMRS user (RESEARCH.md 3a). The FHIR2 module has no DocumentReference, Composition or ImagingStudy: a report is read from its DiagnosticReport (the file in presentedForm when present, else its values as a text-only report). No images, no signature.

presets.name: HAPI FHIR or any plain FHIR R4 server
presets.status: by standard, not tested with the product
presets.notes: Any FHIR R4 server that is not in NRCeS shapes. Give the FHIR base address (for HAPI usually ending in /fhir), the sign-in the server uses, and the identifier system of the hospital number if the server needs system|value.

presets.name: International HIS with FHIR R4 (Epic / Oracle Health (Cerner) / TrakCare style)
presets.status: by standard, not tested with the product
presets.notes: FHIR R4 with a bearer token or OAuth2 client credentials (client id and secret). Epic and Oracle Health normally ask for SMART backend services with a signed JWT (RESEARCH.md 1d and section 2), which Vaidyx-TB does not have yet: this preset works only where the site issues a client secret or a token. No Indian hospital on Epic was found; TrakCare and Cerner sites exist.

presets.name: NIC e-Hospital / NextGen eHospital
presets.status: by standard, not tested with the product
presets.notes: No public API found; needs NIC cooperation; use HL7 v2 files or a report folder if the hospital can export (RESEARCH.md 1a). ABDM compliant means the product pushes record bundles through the ABDM gateway after patient consent; it is not a FHIR server to query (RESEARCH.md section 2). If NIC can hand over those bundles as files, choose 'ABDM record bundles'. Ask the vendor for FHIR R4 or HL7 v2 export.

presets.name: C-DAC e-Sushrut (HMIS)
presets.status: by standard, not tested with the product
presets.notes: No public API found; needs C-DAC cooperation; use HL7 v2 files or a report folder if the hospital can export (RESEARCH.md 1a: C-DAC says HL7 is built in, with no interface document). ABDM compliant means the product pushes record bundles through the ABDM gateway after patient consent; it is not a FHIR server to query (RESEARCH.md section 2). If C-DAC can hand over those bundles as files, choose 'ABDM record bundles'. Ask the vendor for FHIR R4 or HL7 v2 export.

presets.name: Insta HMS (Practo)
presets.status: by standard, not tested with the product
presets.notes: The vendor names 'out-of-the-box HL7 and API based integrations', with no public document (RESEARCH.md 1c). Ask the vendor for FHIR R4 or HL7 v2 export (ORU^R01 result files with the report PDF); if neither is offered, choose 'Report folder with an index file'.

presets.name: KareXpert
presets.status: by standard, not tested with the product
presets.notes: Only an ABDM connector is announced (a vendor claim); no FHIR, HL7 or API document was found (RESEARCH.md 1c). ABDM compliant means the product pushes record bundles through the ABDM gateway after patient consent; it is not a FHIR server to query (RESEARCH.md section 2). Start with a report folder; ask the vendor for FHIR R4 or HL7 v2 export, or for its ABDM record bundles as files.

presets.name: MocDoc
presets.status: by standard, not tested with the product
presets.notes: The vendor says 'FHIR R4 compatible' and ABDM milestones 1 to 3 (vendor claims), with no API document found (RESEARCH.md 1c). ABDM compliant means the product pushes record bundles through the ABDM gateway after patient consent; it is not a FHIR server to query (RESEARCH.md section 2). Start with a report folder; ask the vendor for FHIR R4 or HL7 v2 export, or for its ABDM record bundles as files.

presets.name: Napier Healthcare
presets.status: by standard, not tested with the product
presets.notes: Interface not known: nothing was found about this product (RESEARCH.md 1c). Start with a report folder; ask the vendor for FHIR R4 or HL7 v2 export.

presets.name: Akhil Systems Miracle HIS
presets.status: by standard, not tested with the product
presets.notes: Interface not known: no primary source (RESEARCH.md 1c; a third-party list says ABDM yes, FHIR partial). Start with a report folder; ask the vendor for FHIR R4 or HL7 v2 export.

presets.name: LIS / RIS with HL7 v2 results
presets.status: by standard, not tested with the product
presets.notes: Any lab, radiology or hospital system that can send HL7 v2 results (ORU^R01, with the report PDF in an OBX of type ED where possible): what most commercial vendors name (Insta HMS, Attune LIS, Birlamedisoft; RESEARCH.md 1c and 3b). The hospital's interface engine or a small relay writes one file per message into the folder.

presets.name: Report folder with an index file
presets.status: by standard, not tested with the product
presets.notes: For a hospital with no API: report PDFs in a folder with index.csv (uhid, patient_name, sex, dob or age, visit_no, visit_type, report_id, report_type, report_date, status, signed_by, file).

presets.name: ABDM record bundles
presets.status: by standard, not tested with the product
presets.notes: ABDM health-record documents (FHIR document bundles in NRCeS shapes, guide version 6.5.0) saved as .json files in a folder: how an ABDM compliant product (e-Hospital, e-Sushrut, Bahmni, MediXcel, Eka Care and others) can hand over the bundles it creates. No live ABDM gateway and no consent flow here (RESEARCH.md 3c).
